name: NEO broad verified-flow PAPER execution and outcome feedback
policy: A broader market candidate rule joins four selective rules in the shared PAPER account. Every entry still requires fresh confirmed exact-pool flow, completed same-pool safety, independently verified price, executable quotes and strict risk/cost limits. Current-policy closed trades are attributed to matched rules; a rule may be throttled only after at least 12 closes show weak posterior win rate and negative net PnL. This does not establish or promise profitability.
integrity_note: Mandatory fresh confirmed flow coverage, exact pool/mint checks, complete same-pool safety, independent price confirmation, modeled expected round-trip cost at most 1.5%, conservative cost at most 2.5%, bounded quotes and uncapped actual modeled losses.

execution_gates: fresh confirmed 30-second exact-pool PumpSwap flow with at least three swaps from two wallets and at least 1.2x buy/sell USD
fresh completed safety report for the exact mint and pool
fresh buy/sell quotes with expected round-trip cost at most 1.5% and conservative cost at most 2.5%
available shared cash and daily/drawdown risk limits

runtime_note: Primary PAPER account runs one broad verified-flow candidate rule and four selective entry rules against one shared balance; bounded same-policy outcome feedback is shown separately from isolated validated training, and no path can send live orders.
stop_execution_note: Planned net stop -5%; all observed gap losses and unavailable liquidation risk retained. Never clamps a loss or realizes native SOL as USDC.
hash_change_reasons: Professional local PAPER review: repair actual-worker ownership and persistence retry handling, validate and bound loss feedback, and recheck liquidation availability/drawdown at entry commit. Preserve history and admission safeguards. Profitability and the 80 percent win-rate target remain unvalidated. User-requested strategy review: archive repeated losing research entries while retaining exit management and ledgers, correct market/flow diagnostic attribution and show honest training state. Current promoted profitability remains unvalidated.

support_file_changes.backend/live_tape.py: Prioritize market candidates within the existing RPC budget and contain repeated projection write failures so stale coverage fails closed while the recorder retries.
support_file_changes.backend/strategy_lab.py: Preserve funded entry safeguards and independent ledgers; retry durable writes and restore persistence before entries. Stop retired research entries while continuing registered exits. Distinguish promoted market mismatches from unavailable flow.
support_file_changes.backend/lab_position_marks.py: Choose the newest exact-mint/pool observation by source timestamp rather than receipt time, so a newly received stale cache row cannot mask a more recent market observation; retain freshness checks.
support_file_changes.backend/lab_dashboard_projection.py: Expose preserved retirement evidence, archive summary and actual market mismatch diagnostics without dropping positions or balances.
support_file_changes.backend/market_monitor.py: Preserve verified flow, safety, price, cost, cash and exposure guards; retain original matching rules for descriptive learning and recheck liquidation availability and drawdown under the final entry lock.
support_file_changes.backend/engine_entry_policy.py: Explain broad market, confirmed-flow and loss-feedback holds in entry diagnostics.
support_file_changes.backend/lab_activity.py: Keep the research cost model intact while allowing a caller to enforce a stricter bounded round-trip cost cap for funded PAPER entries.
support_file_changes.backend/winner_ensemble.py: Validate unique finite closed outcomes, report excluded data, bound statistics to the latest 100 closes per rule and retain actual overlapping outcomes; held rules require reviewed policy or new valid evidence, never a timed resume.
support_file_changes.backend/paper_training.py: Require fresh complete exact-pool flow before allocating quote capacity to learner route evidence
support_file_changes.backend/training_bridge.py: Coalesce identical snapshots and keep training off the exit path; prevent worker restart after bridge shutdown so PAPER services stop without leaving orphan learners.
support_file_changes.backend/training_quote_probe.py: Bounded read-only two-way exact-pool Jupiter quote evidence for isolated PAPER learning
support_file_changes.backend/paper_state_reset.py: Archive and reset recorder/quote-probe diagnostics together with PAPER history so each authorized clean session starts with truthful zeroed counters.
support_file_changes.backend/momentum_rush_brain.py: Causal bounded observation scoring and own-ledger memory; 80 percent remains an unvalidated research target.
support_file_changes.backend/paper_lab_metrics.py: Read-only per-book measurements, malformed/truncated history detection and descriptive sample uncertainty; no automatic promotion.
support_file_changes.backend/promoted_entry_guard.py: Prospective funded-PAPER admission requires fresh 30-second confirmed exact-pool swap evidence, completed same-pool safety review, and modeled round-trip cost no greater than half the 3% net stop; policy does not claim an edge or rewrite history.
support_file_changes.scripts/start_local_paper.ps1: Record the actual Python worker through a unique-token handshake; verify runner identity, creation time and listener ownership within a bounded startup wait.
support_file_changes.tests/test_tape_execution_repair.py: Verify that the live tape prioritizes eligible moderate-activity candidates while preserving PumpSwap-only and pinned-pool behavior.
support_file_changes.scripts/local_paper_service.py: Publish the actual worker identity, restrict handshake paths to isolated runtime and honor cancellation after slow imports.
support_file_changes.backend/lab_strategy_lifecycle.py: Retire repeated observed losses only in the same validated PAPER research regime; keep original evidence, all money/history and normal position exits. Require negative total and both chronological halves plus bounded sample/win evidence. No timed reactivation or profitability promise.
